name: herdr-worker-orchestrator-marketplace
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the herdr-worker-orchestrator plugin (Claude Code orchestrator + Herdr-managed CLI worker pattern).

plugins.name: herdr-worker-orchestrator
plugins.description: Claude Code as orchestrator, CLI agent workers of any Herdr-supported kind (agy, codex, ...) running in Herdr-managed panes, coordinated via a stateful .agents/ ledger with task tracking, worker isolation, and diff-based review.
